title: Implement the selected iOS 16.5 Bluetooth daemon and vendor adaptation
acceptance: Inspect explicitly supplied selected iOS16.5 transport/registry/control-socket and BlueTool XPC contracts instead of assuming iOS16.7/18 binary layouts
Compile actual authenticated stream/control and lifecycle integration with selected XNU; initialization reports ready only after real backend readiness
Audit Apple/Broadcom versus QCA opcode semantics and report unsupported features truthfully; no blanket fabricated-success rewrites or chip capability claims
Host tests cover asynchronous callbacks, command status, cancellation, daemon restart and ownership without claiming device pairing/profiles
steps: Recover selected frontend ABI from explicit local inputs
Implement control/BlueTool and semantic command routing
Build and test lifecycle/error paths before native OS qualification
